22.name: waits for social worker reply
22.description: Asha leaves her phone face down while waiting for the social worker to respond.
evidence: The phone stayed face down on the counter for the length of time it took the kettle she had not turned on to fail to whistle, and then it lit up against the laminate with the social worker's reply.

22.name: receives step-down bed confirmation
22.description: Asha reads that the county step-down bed has been confirmed for two o'clock and that intake will contact her for consent and transport.
evidence: Asha turned it over and read that the county step-down bed had been confirmed for two o'clock, that intake would call her once for consent and once more before transport, and that Marcus had been told.

22.name: pauses in apartment
22.description: Asha sets the phone down and briefly lets herself remain in the apartment without giving anything else away.
evidence: She set the phone down again and stood with her hands flat on the counter and let the apartment be the apartment for another half minute, the one room she had not given away,

22.name: answers unknown billing call
22.description: Asha receives a call from Bridgepoint's billing line asking whether her deposit should be held or refunded because the admissions packet is incomplete.
evidence: and then her phone lit a second time with a number she did not know and a Trenton area code, and Bridgepoint's billing line was on the other end asking whether the deposit she had wired on Friday should be held against the bed they were still holding for her father or released back to her account, because the admissions packet had come back without the co-signer's notarized signature and the facility could not place him on Wednesday without it.

22.name: asks to hold deposit
22.description: Asha tells the billing agent to keep the deposit applied to the bed instead of returning it.
evidence: Asha turned the phone over and told the billing agent to hold the deposit where it sat.

22.name: requests forty-eight-hour extension
22.description: Asha asks for forty-eight hours to secure the missing signature and says she will have an answer by Wednesday afternoon.
evidence: She heard the woman's keyboard pause on the other end, and into that pause she asked for forty-eight hours against the bed, said it plainly, said her brother's signature was the gap and that she would have an answer before three on Wednesday.

22.name: billing agent records request
22.description: The billing agent repeats Asha's request in a practiced, resigned tone, implying this kind of delay is familiar.
evidence: The agent read back the request in the flat voice of someone who had said yes to this before and watched the yes expire,

22.name: promises answer by Wednesday
22.description: Asha tells the agent she will have an answer before three on Wednesday, and the agent accepts without surprise.
evidence: that she would have an answer before three on Wednesday.
The agent read back the request in the flat voice of someone who had said yes to this before and watched the yes expire, and Asha did not correct any of it.

22.name: ends call and sets phone down
22.description: After the call ends, Asha places the phone face down on the counter where it had been warming.
evidence: When the call ended she set the phone face down again on the same square of laminate it had warmed before

22.name: realizes she repeated Friday's mistake
22.description: Asha understands that she has made the same losing bet again, knowingly and in daylight.
evidence: she understood that she had just made the bet she lost on Friday a second time, in daylight, with her eyes open

22.name: hesitates between two calls
22.description: Asha remains at the counter, thinking about the addendum and Claire's number, but chooses not to contact either.
evidence: Asha stayed at the counter with her palm still flat against the back of the phone
She thought about the addendum on the table behind her, the line where Marcus's name was printed under hers, and about Claire's number sitting one screen-tap away, and she did not reach for either.

22.name: buys forty-eight hours
22.description: Asha recognizes that she has gained forty-eight hours and feels the burden of having to use them without changing her mind twice.
evidence: She had bought herself forty-eight hours, and what she felt, standing there, was not relief but the specific weight of having to spend them not deciding twice.

22.name: examines addendum with Marcus's name
22.description: Asha lifts the addendum and studies the printed line with Marcus's name beneath hers.
evidence: After a moment she did move, just enough to lift the addendum off the table and hold it level under the kitchen light.
Marcus's name was printed in the small block beneath hers, the line under it still blank

22.name: reads Marcus's name on addendum
22.description: Asha reads Marcus's printed name on the addendum and notices the blank line beneath it.
evidence: rcus's name was printed in the small block beneath hers, the line under it still blank
She read the name the way she would have read a clause in someone else's contract

22.name: sets addendum back carefully
22.description: She places the page back on the same spot and aligns its corner precisely, signaling hesitation and control.
evidence: then set the page back down on the same square of grain it had come from, corner aligned to corner
the small precision of that gesture was the only part of the decision she was willing to make right now

22.name: chooses not to call anyone
22.description: Asha refuses to act immediately, leaving the phone untouched and declining to call Claire or the notary.
evidence: She did not slide it away and she did not pick up the phone
The phone stayed face down where she had left it
She did not reach for Claire's number, and she did not reach for the notary's

22.name: lets forty-eight-hour deadline continue
22.description: Asha recognizes that the forty-eight hours she bought are passing as she delays making a decision.
evidence: the forty-eight hours she had bought herself began, in the quiet, to feel like exactly what they were: time she had agreed to spend looking at this
the forty-eight hours kept running the way she had agreed they would

22.name: rechecks Marcus's name
22.description: Asha lifts the addendum again and rereads Marcus's name, focusing on the blank line beneath it.
evidence: After a minute she lifted the addendum again, not to sign it but to read Marcus's name once more
She held the page level under the kitchen light and let her eyes settle on the blank line beneath his printed name

22.name: maintains decision through repeated hesitation
22.description: She repeats the same careful handling of the page, showing she is still not ready to commit.
evidence: After another minute Asha lifted the addendum a third time
and nudged the corner until it matched the corner beneath it

22.name: touches blank signature line
22.description: Asha places her fingertip on the blank line, stopping just short of signing.
evidence: let her fingertip rest on the blank line be

22.name: waits out the forty-eight hours
22.description: The forty-eight-hour period continues to run as Asha waits, having already agreed to the deadline.
evidence: the forty-eight hours kept running the way she had agreed they would.

22.name: reviews the addendum again
22.description: Asha lifts the addendum for a third time, continuing to scrutinize the document.
evidence: After another minute Asha lifted the addendum a third time

22.name: traces Marcus's signature line
22.description: Asha runs her fingertip along the blank line beneath Marcus's printed name, feeling the paper's texture and the printer's fading toner.
evidence: let her fingertip rest on the blank line beneath Marcus's printed name, tracing it once from the left margin to where the toner thinned at the end.
She did not press hard enough to leave a mark on the paper, only enough to feel the slight catch of fiber under her nail where the printer had run dry.

22.name: sets the page back in place
22.description: Asha puts the addendum down on the same spot and aligns its corner carefully with the page beneath it.
evidence: Then she set the page down on its same square of grain and squared the corner with the pad of her thumb until it matched the one beneath.

22.name: leaves the phone face down
22.description: Asha keeps the phone face down beside her, signaling continued waiting and inaction.
evidence: The phone stayed face down beside her.

22.name: realizes no different page will come
22.description: Asha understands that the deadline will not produce any new document beyond the one already in front of her.
evidence: She understood, without saying it to herself in those words, that the forty-eight hours were not going to give her a different page than the one already in front of her.
